scope: six-BMI270 measurement-only, not executed on hardware
sdk_choice_authority: scoped firmware-owner choice, not individually human-selected

clock.apb: SOC_MOD_CLK_APB, no dynamic frequency scaling or application sleep
clock.rationale: The lowest non-FPGA S3 CPU option supports this low-rate polling application; not an actual power/current guarantee.

memory.rationale: N8R2 Quad flash can be addressed conservatively through DIO; internal RAM suffices and no PSRAM/OPI initialization is needed.

spi.cs: six real hardware CS outputs; each from committed REV5_PIN_IMU_CS_*_GPIO
spi.transfer_mode: SDK half-duplex transaction, separate MOSI/MISO wires, 8-bit command, no SDK dummy phase
spi.read_callback: SensorAPI supplies read-bit-set address and len including one dummy byte. SDK receives all len bytes; SensorAPI alone discards dummy.
spi.timeout_lifetime: Persistent per-device descriptor and buffers retained after a timeout; affected context is not reused.
spi.rationale: S3 SOC_SPI_PERIPH_CS_NUM(SPI2_HOST)=6; SDK passes this capacity to its bus lock. No software-CS workaround or topology change is necessary. 1MHz is a conservative owner setting, not six-drop electrical qualification.

imu.driver: Bosch BMI270_SensorAPI v2.86.1, unmodified official subset
imu.init: All-six quiescent-bus CS selection before any clocked traffic; per-device bmi270_init includes soft reset, SPI reselection, complete configuration upload and internal-status check.
imu.performance: BMI2_PERF_OPT_MODE for accel filter and gyro filter/noise fields; no application filtering
imu.data: 12 register bytes from BMI2_ACC_X_LSB_ADDR decoded to 6 uncorrected signed 16-bit counts
imu.raw_api_rationale: Use official bmi2_get_regs rather than bmi2_get_sensor_data, whose parser applies gyro cross-axis compensation/remapping.
imu.data_ready: Require both BMI2_DRDY_ACC and BMI2_DRDY_GYR before each raw block read; this does not establish six-sensor simultaneity.

uart.framing: REV5B1 <ASCII JSON object> LF; maximum 512 bytes including LF
uart.mode: log-only; RX is not parsed and there are no command/ACK/drive/arm handlers
uart.timebase: esp_timer_get_time(), host microseconds, begin/end bracket; physical accuracy/synchrony UNQUALIFIED
uart.boot_epoch_reason: A reset-unique persistent epoch is not implemented in this deliberately log-only subset; null is explicit, not a fabricated unique ID. No NVS/RNG/ADC/radio initialization is added for a token. The old full command contract is not implemented or rewritten.
uart.transport: bounded synchronous nonblocking FIFO writes with explicit cumulative dropped-line count; no unbounded application queue
uart.j202_pin4: SENSE_ONLY, never configured or treated as a rail-valid input

registration_proposals: Exact SDK/API/source locators and SHA-256 bindings will be stored locally in source-lock.json; no new canonical DS IDs allocated.
